nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $g$ be a natural number that is a primitive root modulo $p$, where a primitive root modulo $n$ is a residue class modulo $n$ of multiplicative order $\varphi(n)$. Then there is a natural number $k$ such that $g + kp$ is a primitive root modulo $p^\ell$ for every $\ell \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Gauss's theorem on primitive roots modulo prime powers

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $g$ be a natural number that is a primitive root modulo $p$, that is, a residue class modulo $p$ of multiplicative order $\varphi(p) = p - 1$. Let $P_g$ be the set of units $x$ modulo $p^2$ with $x \equiv g \pmod p$. Then exactly one $x \in P_g$ has multiplicative order $p - 1$ modulo $p^2$.
nodes.title: The lift of order $p - 1$ of a primitive root

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $x_0$ be a unit modulo $p^2$, and let $P_{x_0}$ be the set of units $x$ modulo $p^2$ with $x \equiv x_0 \pmod p$. There is exactly one $x \in P_{x_0}$ whose multiplicative order modulo $p^2$ equals the multiplicative order of its reduction modulo $p$.
nodes.title: Unique order-preserving element of a fiber modulo $p^2$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $g$ be a natural number that is a primitive root modulo $p$, where a primitive root modulo $n$ is a residue class modulo $n$ of multiplicative order $\varphi(n)$. Then there is exactly one $m \in \{0, 1, \dots, p - 1\}$ such that $g + mp$ is not a primitive root modulo $p^2$, and $g + kp$ is a primitive root modulo $p^2$ for every other $k \in \{0, 1, \dots, p - 1\}$.
nodes.title: Exactly one lift of a primitive root fails modulo $p^2$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $a$ be a natural number coprime to $p$. Writing $\operatorname{ord}_n(b)$ for the multiplicative order of $b$ modulo $n$, there is exactly one $m \in \{0, 1, \dots, p - 1\}$ such that $\operatorname{ord}_{p^2}(a + mp) = \operatorname{ord}_p(a)$.
nodes.title: Unique order-preserving lift modulo $p^2$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$ and a unit $a$ of $\mathbb{Z}/p^2\mathbb{Z}$, the fiber $P_a$ is the set of units $x$ of $\mathbb{Z}/p^2\mathbb{Z}$ with $x \equiv a \pmod p$, that is, the units whose image under the reduction map $(\mathbb{Z}/p^2\mathbb{Z})^\times \to (\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^\times$ equals the image of $a$.
nodes.title: Fibers of reduction modulo $p$ on units modulo $p^2$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $f$ be a group endomorphism of $(\mathbb{Z}/p^2\mathbb{Z})^\times$, and let $a$ be a unit modulo $p^2$. Writing $P_b$ for the set of units $x$ modulo $p^2$ with $x \equiv b \pmod p$, the image of $P_a$ under $f$ is contained in $P_{f(a)}$.
nodes.title: Endomorphisms of the units modulo $p^2$ respect the fibers

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $a$, $\operatorname{ord}_n(a)$ is the multiplicative order of the residue class of $a$ in the unit group $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times$ when $a$ is coprime to $n$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Multiplicative order modulo $n$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $a$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $a$ coprime to $p$. Writing $\operatorname{ord}_n(b)$ for the multiplicative order of $b$ modulo $n$, the order $\operatorname{ord}_{p^2}(a + kp)$ is either $\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$ or $p \cdot \operatorname{ord}_p(a)$.
nodes.title: The order of $a + kp$ modulo $p^2$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $a$ be a unit modulo $p^2$, and let $n$ be a natural number coprime to $p$ and to the multiplicative order of $a$. Writing $P_b$ for the set of units $x$ modulo $p^2$ with $x \equiv b \pmod p$, the map $x \mapsto x^n$ is injective on $P_a$, maps $P_a$ onto $P_{a^n}$, and preserves the multiplicative order of every element of $P_a$.
nodes.title: Power maps on the fibers modulo $p^2$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $g$ be a natural number that is a primitive root modulo $p$. If $k$ is a natural number not divisible by $p$, then $g^p + kp$ is a primitive root modulo $p^\ell$ for every natural number $\ell > 1$.
nodes.title: Primitive roots modulo $p^\ell$ of the form $g^p + kp$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, this is the group homomorphism $(\mathbb{Z}/p^2\mathbb{Z})^\times \to (\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^\times$ induced on units by the reduction ring homomorphism $\mathbb{Z}/p^2\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, which sends the class of $x$ modulo $p^2$ to the class of $x$ modulo $p$.
nodes.title: Reduction of units modulo $p^2$ to units modulo $p$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
